stories.title: Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude AI 文字偵測功能 / Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others

sources.title: Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude AI 文字偵測功能 / Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude AI 文字偵測功能
sources.title_en: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
sources.title_original: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
sources.summary: Anthropic is launching an API that lets regulators, media outlets, and researchers check whether text carries Claude's digital watermark. The EU AI Act now requires invisible watermarks in AI-generated text. Critics warn the technology could hurt text quality and create transparency problems where contracts ban AI use. The article Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出一個應用程式介面 (API)，允許監管機構、媒體和研究人員檢查文字是否帶有 Claude's 數位浮水印。歐盟人工智慧法案現已要求在人工智慧生成的文字中新增不可見的浮水印。批評人士警告稱，這項技術可能會損害文字品質，並在合約禁止使用人工智慧的情況下造成透明度問題。文章《Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude 人工智慧文字偵測功能》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

stories.title: Anthropic's 和 Claude Fable 5.1 承諾以最多 45% 的成本提供更好的編碼和研究。 / Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less

sources.title: Anthropic's 和 Claude Fable 5.1 承諾以最多 45% 的成本提供更好的編碼和研究。 / Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's 和 Claude Fable 5.1 承諾以最多 45% 的成本提供更好的編碼和研究。
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less
sources.summary: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, its most capable AI models yet. Fable 5.1 doubles its predecessor's score on Terminal-Bench-Science and improves agentic coding by over 30 percent. Costs drop by up to 45 percent for long, autonomous runs with many tool calls. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了迄今為止功能最強大的 AI 模型 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Mythos 5.1。 Fable 5.1 在終端基準測試 (Terminal-Bench-Science) 上的得分是其前代產品的兩倍，智能體編碼能力提升超過 30%。對於需要多次工具呼叫的長時間自主運行，成本最多可降低 45%。文章《Anthropic's 和 Claude Fable 5.1 承諾以最多 45% 的成本實現更優的編碼和研究》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title_en: Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface
sources.title_original: Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface
sources.summary: As AI adoption gathers pace, so does the evolution of the infrastructure that supports it. New standards and connectors keep appearing, and the ones that catch on spread through the ecosystem within months rather than years. That speed strengthens what AI can do, but makes it very difficult for security teams to maintain sufficient protections. […] The post Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface appeared first on AI News .
sources.summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧的普及，支撐其發展的基礎設施也加速演進。新的標準和連接器層出不窮，那些被廣泛接受的方案往往只需幾個月而非幾年就能在整個生態系統中傳播開來。這種快速發展增強了人工智慧的能力，但也使得安全團隊難以維持足夠的防護。 […] 這篇文章《為什麼 MCP 伺服器正成為人工智慧最新的攻擊面》最初發表於 AI News。

stories.title: Google's 選舉人工智慧概述晦澀難懂，資訊來源有限，有時還帶有傾向性。 / Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides

sources.title: Google's 選舉人工智慧概述晦澀難懂，資訊來源有限，有時還帶有傾向性。 / Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
sources.title_zh: Google's 選舉人工智慧概述晦澀難懂，資訊來源有限，有時還帶有傾向性。
sources.title_en: Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
sources.title_original: Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
sources.summary: Using access granted under the EU's Digital Services Act, the German advocacy group AlgorithmWatch ran 4,480 election-related search queries on Google and analyzed the AI Overviews that came back. Google showed the overviews inconsistently and leaned on a small pool of sources, chief among them its own platform YouTube. Whether earlier safeguards against AI answers on election questions still apply, Google left open. The article Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 德國倡導組織AlgorithmWatch利用歐盟《數位服務法》授予的存取許可權，在Google平臺上進行了4480次與選舉相關的搜尋查詢，並分析了返回的AI概覽。 Google平臺顯示的概覽並不一致，且依賴少量資訊來源，其中最主要的是其自身的YouTube平臺。 Google平臺並未明確說明先前針對AI在選舉議題上作答的保障措施是否仍然有效。文章《Google's選舉AI概覽晦澀難懂、資訊來源有限且有時帶有傾向性》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.title_original: Google's AI search dropped its emergency-call advice over nationalities but still flags people from Facebook
sources.summary: "Please get to a safe place or call emergency services": That's the advice Google's AI search gave users who typed that they were alone with an African, Indian, or Pakistani. The article Google's AI search dropped its emergency-call advice over nationalities but still flags people from Facebook appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 「請前往安全地點或撥打緊急服務電話」：這是Google's人工智慧搜尋給那些輸入自己與非洲人、印度人或巴基斯坦人單獨相處的用戶給予的建議。文章《Google's人工智慧搜尋不再根據國籍給予撥打緊急服務電話的建議，但仍會標記來自Facebook的使用者》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

sources.summary: 主打資安防禦AI模型的新創公司Corma宣佈完成6,000萬美元種子輪募資，本輪由紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）領投，Khosla Ventures與Coatue參與投資。Corma也同步結束隱身階段，公開旗下首款AI基礎模型，讓AI代理與資安團隊共同處理企業環境中的威脅偵測與防禦工作。

sources.title: 蘋果 指控 OpenAI 銷毀證據 / Apple accuses OpenAI of destroying evidence
sources.title_zh: 蘋果 指控 OpenAI 銷毀證據
sources.title_en: Apple accuses OpenAI of destroying evidence
sources.title_original: Apple accuses OpenAI of destroying evidence
sources.summary: Apple is pushing for "expedited discovery" in its legal battle against OpenAI over concerns the company is actively destroying evidence, as reported earlier by Bloomberg. In a filing on Monday, Apple alleges OpenAI only just handed over a MacBook used by a former employee at the center of the lawsuit, which contained discussions about "destroying […]
sources.summary_zh: 根據彭博社先前報道，蘋果 正在其與 OpenAI 的法律訴訟中，要求“加快取證”，原因是該公司擔心 OpenAI 正在積極銷毀證據。 蘋果 在週一提交的檔案中聲稱，OpenAI 直到最近才交出訴訟核心人物——一名前僱員使用過的 MacBook，其中包含有關「銷毀證據」的討論記錄。

stories.title: Claude Fable 5.1 為我製作了一個非常棒的動畫鵜鶘 / Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 為我製作了一個非常棒的動畫鵜鶘 / Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
sources.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.1 為我製作了一個非常棒的動畫鵜鶘
sources.title_en: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
sources.title_original: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
sources.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. It took 23.8 seconds and cost 10.017 cents . I bumped that up
sources.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

primary_item.title_en: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
primary_item.title_original: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
primary_item.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. It took 23.8 seconds and cost 10.017 cents . I bumped that up
primary_item.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

sources.title_en: datasette-mcp 0.2
sources.title_original: datasette-mcp 0.2
sources.summary: Release: datasette-mcp 0.2 "rows" from execute_sql is now an array of objects. Previously it was an array of arrays. This should help weaker models avoid losing track of which positional array element maps to which column. #1 Now depends on mcp>=2.1.1 . This is the first non-alpha release of the plugin. I'm confident it's ready as I've been using it quite a bit myself. Tags: datasette , model-context-protocol
sources.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-mcp 0.2 版本中，execute_sql 傳回的「rows」現在是一個物件數組。之前它是一個陣列的陣列。這應該有助於較弱的模型避免遺失數組中每個位置元素與對應列的對應關係。 #1 現在依賴 mcp>=2.1.1。這是該插件的第一個非 alpha 版本。我自己已經使用過一段時間，所以我相信它已經準備就緒。標籤：datasette，模型上下文協議

stories.title: Codex 捆綁 LibreOffice / Codex bundles LibreOffice

sources.title: Codex 捆綁 LibreOffice / Codex bundles LibreOffice
sources.title_zh: Codex 捆綁 LibreOffice
sources.title_en: Codex bundles LibreOffice
sources.title_original: Codex bundles LibreOffice
sources.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. The OpenAI Codex desktop app (since rebranded to just ChatGPT) has 1.7GB of stuff in there in a folder called codex-primary-runtime , including a full Python installation, a full Node.js installation, and native binaries for Poppler , git, and the LibreOffice open source office suite (which forked from OpenOffice.org in 2010): The ~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents folder includes skills which tell Codex how to find and use those binaries. Tags: codex , generative-ai , openai , ai , llms , openoffice , open-source
sources.summary_zh: 當我用 OmniDiskSweeper 在我的 ~/.cache/ 資料夾裡閒逛時，發現了一些有趣的東西。 OpenAI Codex 桌面應用程式（現已更名為 ChatGPT）在名為 codex-primary-runtime 的資料夾中佔用了 1.7GB 的空間，其中包括完整的 Python 安裝、完整的 Node.js 安裝，以及 Poppler、git 和 LibreOffice 開源檔案~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents 資料夾包含一些技能，這些技能告訴 Codex 如何尋找和使用這些二進位檔案。標籤：codex、generative-ai、openai、ai、llms、openoffice、開源

stories.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範

sources.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
sources.title_zh: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
sources.title_original: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
sources.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

stories.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模

sources.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
sources.title_zh: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
sources.title_original: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
sources.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

stories.title: 阿里巴巴 更新了 Qwen3.8-Max，但 -0902 檢查點映射仍然不清楚。 / Alibaba updates Qwen3.8-Max, leaves the -0902 checkpoint mapping unclear

sources.title: 阿里巴巴 更新了 Qwen3.8-Max，但 -0902 檢查點映射仍然不清楚。 / Alibaba updates Qwen3.8-Max, leaves the -0902 checkpoint mapping unclear
sources.title_zh: 阿里巴巴 更新了 Qwen3.8-Max，但 -0902 檢查點映射仍然不清楚。
sources.title_en: Alibaba updates Qwen3.8-Max, leaves the -0902 checkpoint mapping unclear
sources.title_original: Alibaba updates Qwen3.8-Max, leaves the -0902 checkpoint mapping unclear
